summary: Example eAPI group_vars uses httpapi, arista.eos.eos, user, vaulted password, become enable and proxy_env with http_proxy; remove proxy_env for direct access or use https_proxy for HTTPS proxies.
questions: What group_vars do I need for Arista eAPI?
How do I use a web proxy with eAPI?

answer_card.title: EOS eAPI group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.httpapi
ansible_network_os: arista.eos.eos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
proxy_env:
  http_proxy: http://proxy.example.com:8080
```
Remove `proxy_env` for direct access; use `https_proxy` if the proxy is HTTPS.
